answer: At t+0, a beacon triggers a random identity challenge. Operators on schedule monitor beacon messages and respond with unique delta codes. If an operator fails, their garden of tokens willow, forfeiting epoch 37 rewards. The verifier checks codes at epoch close, ensuring only valid agents participate. If cloning occurs, attackers lose 10 tokens each, while a legitimate agent gains 1 token, ensuring the attacker ends 9 tokens worse off.
